newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: INSIGHT - Dutch chartists stay upbeat about AEX.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Dutch chartists stay upbeat about AEX.

text.p: Dutch technical analysts remained positive about the uptrend in the AEX share index on Monday, continuing to see the possibilities for gains in the index which has risen nearly 35 percent so far in 1997.
Two houses have put first resistance at 875 on the AEX, with the index said still moving within the boundaries of a rising trend channel amid strong money flows.

Second resistance is set at 900-910 with some advising to use possible dips to buy into Dutch shares. On Monday afternoon the index was up 1.17 points at 871.62, back from an intra-day trading high of 876.23.
The AEX share index closed at 870.45 points last Friday, 8.25 points up from the previous week's close.
Contributor Trend Pvs view Support Resistance

ABN AMRO - This is still a long market. And as long as everybody is still hoping for the correction to buy, there won't be one. The market continues to look solid. On short term OBOS indicators there is still no sign of negative divergence. So don't focus on the short side, but buy on weakness and join the ride up in search for the target of 910. Only a break below 835 will cause problems for the intermediate term trend.

JAAD - There is a big gap between our support levels and the market level because we're in a very volatile market. The fact that our computer comes up with a low support level is an indication that the market is insecure.

ING Barings - The AEX is still moving within the boundaries of a rising trend channel. Strong money flows and positive Advance/Decline ratios confirm the present bull run. It suggests that money keeps pouring into the market, while there is still good internal leadership.

Last week 86 stocks on the Amsterdam exchange reached new 12 month highs, only three touched a new 12 month low. Intermediate support comes in around 865 then around...855. Currently the AEX is running into resistance at 875, at the higher reaches of its rising trend channel. A close below 855 would weaken the market's technicals. Stay bullish unless 855 gives way.

MeesPierson - The markets remain very strong. The index is still moving in an upward trading range, however we do not expect an index above the long and short term resistance levels. We advise investors to use a possible dip to buy Dutch shares.
